definitions.gloss: to touch, to come in contact

examples.japanese: {展示品|てんじひん}に{触|ふ}れないでください。
その{話題|わだい}には{触|ふ}れなかった。

notes:
{触|ふ}れる is an intransitive ichidan verb with two main meanings: to make physical contact and to mention or refer to something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Takes に particle: Xに{触|ふ}れる

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {展示品|てんじひん}に{触|ふ}れないでください: Please don't touch the exhibits
- その{話題|わだい}に{触|ふ}れる: to mention that topic
- {自然|しぜん}に{触|ふ}れる: to experience/connect with nature
- {法|ほう}に{触|ふ}れる: to break the law

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {触|ふ}れる: to touch (slightly formal, often light contact)
- {触|さわ}る: to touch (casual, often implies handling)

REGISTER:
More formal than {触|さわ}る; preferred in written language and polite contexts.
